chart_name: Iron-deficiency anemia / low iron — Veg — Iron-supportive nutrition
general_guidance: Iron-rich foods plus vitamin-C-rich foods; use both plant and animal sources according to preference. CBC, ferritin/iron studies, response, tolerance and cause evaluation.
foods_to_avoid_or_limit: Food is not a substitute for diagnosing bleeding, malabsorption or other causes and prescribing iron when needed. Tea/coffee and some calcium-rich foods may reduce iron absorption; individualize timing around iron-rich meals/supplements. Do not prescribe iron supplements without dose and cause assessment.

chart_name: Irritable bowel syndrome — Veg — Symptom support
general_guidance: Regular meals, adequate fluids as appropriate and an individualized symptom diary. Bowel pattern, pain/bloating, weight, nutrition adequacy and food tolerance.
foods_to_avoid_or_limit: A low-FODMAP trial is temporary, structured and should be supervised with reintroduction. Do not use indefinite broad restriction or diagnose IBS through the app. Bleeding, anemia, unexplained loss, fever or nocturnal/progressive symptoms require medical review.
